name: canopee-sdk-typescript
description: TypeScript client SDK for a Canopee node's identity, storage, and peer-to-peer network over its Unix socket.

scripts.test: npm run build && npm run build:tests && node --test "dist-tests/tests/framing.test.js" "dist-tests/tests/golden.test.js"
scripts.test:vectors: npm run build && npm run build:tests && node --test "dist-tests/tests/golden.test.js"
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && npm run build:tests && node --test "dist-tests/tests/e2e.test.js"
